title: -22 (13) Dānupakāra (1)
text: 1-4 Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 5 Idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena sucaritaṃ carati vācāya sucaritaṃ carati manasā sucaritam carati || tassa sutaṃ hoti Mūlagandhe adhivatthā devā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulā ti || || 6 Tassa evaṃ hoti Ahovatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyyanti || || So annaṃ deti || pānaṃ deti || vatthaṃ deti || yānaṃ deti || mālaṃ deti || gandhaṃ deti || vilepanaṃ deti || seyyaṃ deti || āvasathaṃ deti || padīpeyyaṃ deti || || So kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatīti || || 7 Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu ayam paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā mūlagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || [page 253] XXXI. 23-102. 7] GANDHABBAKĀYA-SAṂYUTTA 253
